occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: Based on information gathered, the operation failed to follow operation policy regarding verification of identification at pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: The children's storage space was not clearly labeled in toddler classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: I did not observe the most recent licensing inspection report posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The daily schedule did not include outdoor play times for morning and afternoon in preschool 1 and toddler rooms. Note: corrected during inspection when schedule updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: I observe two feeding bottles that were not labeled in the infant. Note. this was corrected when caregiver labeled both bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): One staff records evaluated was missing notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: I observe the activity plans not posted in the toddler 1 room. Note: this was corrected when activity plan posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Four staff files evaluated were missing one hour of child maltreatment training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: I observe bottle of Moltrin medication on a bottom cart in the classroom accessible to children. Note: corrected when staff removed the medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Three staff records evaluated did not have training records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: I did not observe emergency and evacuation diagram posted in the infant room. Note: this was corrected when diagram was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: A review of the operational policies was conducted and found that the parents rights were not included.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: It was found that the annual fire inspection was not conducted. Last inspection was 3/4/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During the investigation it was found that some of the caregivers were using  forms of prohibited punishment, such as hitting, to control unwanted behaviors from the  children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing: A file for twins was not made accessible to review by licensing upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §746.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based on information obtained for the investigation, a caregiver was using their cell phone for personal reasons while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Based on information obtained for the investigation, a child was in care without admission information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on information obtained for the investigation, a caregiver displayed inappropriate discipline towards a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information obtained for the investigation, a caregiver was not maintaining supervision when engaging on their cell phone for personal reasons unrelated to caregiver responsibilities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: During the inspection it was observed that the pre k classroom was watching the cartoon Resses. This cartoon was not related to their planned activities or meeting educational goals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined: During the inspection the operation was re-cited as it was observed that the pre k classroom still did not have interest centers available for use in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Outdoor Play: During the inspection it was observed that the children were not going outside for outdoor play as required. The day of the inspection it was 70 degress and clear.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Outdoor Play (26 TAC §746.2607(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: During the inspection the operation was re-cited as their outdoor activity space was not fully fenced in. While the majority of the playground was surrounded by a fence, there was an area about 4 ft wide that did not have any fencing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink: During the inspection it was observed that both of the diaper changing areas did not have a working sink available for use. This was corrected at the inspection when a sink was added to the infant diaper changing area and water was added to the sink in the toddler diaper changing area so that it would work.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection it was observed that there was exposed metal on the playground, as well as exposed metal from worn down rain gutters. This metal was sharp and a child could be injured if they fell on it or touched it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection it was observed that children under the age of two were observed watching the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the inspection two, 4 month old infants, were observed sleeping in a swing with a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate: During the inspection it was observed that the children in care were watching SpiderMan, which is a PG-13 movie. The children in care were 16 months, 2 year, 3 years, and 10 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined: During the follow-up inspection it was observed that the pre k classroom still did not have interest centers available for use in the classroom. There were puzzles, a handful of toys, and some white boards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths: During the inspection there was a 16 month old baby with a wet diaper that had not been changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths (26 TAC §746.3501(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the follow-up inspection there were at least 4 outlets that were missing their covers, 3 of which were in the room that the children were present in. These were corrected at inspection when they were added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  - 6 Foot High: There is a swimming pool on the property that doers not have fencing to protect children from having access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  - 6 Foot High (26 TAC §746.5007(a))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: During the investigation there was enough evidence to support that the operation was not providing enough accessible toys and equipment to the children in their care for daily use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children (26 TAC §746.2505(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During the investigation it was found that some of the caregivers were using  forms of prohibited punishment, such as hitting, to control unwanted behaviors from the  children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks: During the inspection it was found that the operation was licensed with 15 toilets and 8 sinks and at the time of the inspection only had 10 toilets and 5 sinks that were working and available for children use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks (26 TAC §746.301(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection it was found that at least 7 outlets were not covered throughout the operation in the pre k room and toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: During the inspection it was observed that there was not a hand washing sink in the diaper changing area for the children aged 18 months - 23 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection it was observed that there was 23 children present, with a specified age of 3 years old, with only 1 caregiver present. This group of children was over ratio by 8.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children: During the inspection it was observed that the toddler classroom only had a couple toys available and did not have low shelving for storage of the toys so that the children could play and access the toys without adult supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Items Accessible to Children (26 TAC §746.2505(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the inspection it was found that the inside of some of the toilet bowls had not been cleaned recently with dried pee, and toilet rims had what appeared to be poop dried on one of them. The floors in one of the bathrooms and the carpet in the pre k classroom had visible dirt and other debris. The vents throughout the operation were also crusted with dust and dirt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: During the monitoring inspection it was found that the mounted fire extinguishers were not tagged showing that they had been serviced as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: During the inspection it was found that the operation did not currently have an outdoor play area that was fenced in and available for children's use. Part of the fence had been torn down during hurricane Beryl in July and not replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  - 6 Foot High: During the inspection it was observed that there was an above ground pool next to the playground area, with no fence, protective barrier, or any other requirements for swimming pools being met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  - 6 Foot High (26 TAC §746.5007(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection it was observed that there was an individual present at the operation and caring for the toddlers without a cleared background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: During the inspection it was found that the bus available for use for transportation was not equipped with a fire extinguisher. It was also missing a thermometer from the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined: During the inspection it was observed that the pre k classroom did not have any interest centers available for use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age Interest Centers Clearly Defined (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(A))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
